The visual evidence presented by NASA is riddled with inconsistencies that suggest the Moon landings were filmed on Earth.

A. The Missing Stars in Moon Photos

  • Every photograph taken on the Moon shows a pitch-black sky with no visible stars. This is impossible because, without an atmosphere to scatter light, stars should be clearly visible.
  • NASA claims the camera settings were adjusted for bright lunar surfaces, but even amateur photographers know that stars should still appear in long-exposure shots.
